Vo.bar_b_note: B's furry white-blue coat approaches the owner's naturalistic bar, but A's broken faint frames and the bare neutral stage leave no Palworld appeal or Valheim light to carry it.

Nk.bar_b_note: The plated otter has a clear, distinctive silhouette and a believable ridden pose, but it is dark, low-contrast and has no rim light, so it falls short of Palworld's creature finish.

Kp.bar_b_note: A well-textured boar, but it is a plain real animal about the trainer's height, and the travel frames (floating with no cargo in A, a flat blue slab in B) sink the finish.

Jt.bar_b_note: Blurry ground textures, an even grass carpet, a flat tiled stronghold wall and flat midday light are far from Palworld's density and Valheim's atmosphere, even where A's aftermaths read well.

Fc.bar_b_note: Same boar presentation as Kp: good fur-and-hide surface, but a plain real animal at roughly human height, with a floating carry frame and a slab-water swim frame.

Qq.bar_b_note: A clean, appealing stylised face with readable eyes and a fitting moss-and-leather palette matches a shipping game's character finish, though the cartoon face is softer than the naturalistic creatures.

Uu.bar_b_note: A near-photoreal plain coyote with no Tetherbound elemental identity, a floating carry frame and slab water reads as a stock animal, not a Palworld-class creature.

Wy.bar_b_note: Identical presentation to Uu: a stock-looking coyote with no elemental hook, a floating carry frame in A and a hard-edged blue water slab in B.

Qs.bar_b_note: Murky one-value frames with no visible purple storm sky or lightning, flat magenta telegraph rings, a tiny unreadable player creature and HUD panels covering a third of the screen sink it (A is also blocked by foliage).

top_changes.change: Stormwood fight presentation: replace flat magenta rings with physical telegraphs (stone, lightning, impacts), raise exposure and rim-light both fighters, keep the camera out of trunks and canopy, and shrink or condense the HUD panels
Travel-role staging: ground the carrying pose with visible cargo instead of floating the creature, and replace the flat blue water slab with a real water surface at the waterline

Meadows site dressing and aftermaths: sharper terrain materials, groves and wildflower clusters instead of an even grass carpet, and enemy banners removed or torn down after the win so each aftermath reads clearly
